The site returns a truncated preview; full summary requires Pro. I did not upgrade (would require payment). Below is a full summary I produced instead:

AI is rapidly reshaping many sectors — from healthcare and finance to others — by enabling systems that analyze and act on large, real-time data streams. Advances in machine learning let organizations extract insights and automate complex tasks, improving diagnostics, risk assessment, personalization, and operational efficiency. At the same time, the field faces important ethical and practical challenges: models can reproduce or amplify bias present in their training data, and many systems lack transparency, making it hard to explain or audit decisions. Addressing these issues will require better data practices, transparency and interpretability techniques, regulatory and governance frameworks, and continued research to ensure AI benefits are distributed fairly and safely.
